module: GE extension `core_input_actions`: registry of input actions (what keys/controllers can trigger). It reads the files lua/ge/extensions/core/input/actions/*.json (common actions) and vehicles/<vehicle>/input_actions*.json plus the inputActions of jbeam files (vehicle-specific actions), caches them, creates the required ActionMaps on the C++ side and translates an action into command parameters for the engine. A modder uses it to trigger an action by name or list the available actions.
usage:
extensions.load('core_input_actions')
local actions = core_input_actions.getActiveActions()   -- table uniqueName -> definition
core_input_actions.triggerDownUp('toggleMenues')       -- simulates press + release
notes: Unique name: a vehicle action is renamed '<vehicle>__<action>' (nameToUniqueName) to avoid collisions between vehicles; common actions keep their name.

Fields of an action definition (read in the code): cat (category, see core_input_categories), ctx ('vlua' default for vehicle, 'tlua', 'elua', 'bvlua'; 'slua' replaced by 'elua', 'ts' and 'ui' deprecated), actionMap, onDown / onUp / onChange / onRelative (Lua code strings), isCentered, vehicle, namespace ('common' = not specific), source (added = file path).

Tokens replaced in the command strings by executeCommand: VALUE, VEHICLEID, FILTERTYPE (-1), PLAYER (0 by default), TRIGGERID, ANGLE (900), LOCKTYPE (0). Replacement by simple substring gsub: avoid these words in an action's code.
Active/inactive: an action is inactive if license.isAllowedActionsPath refuses its file, or if the path contains '_nonshipping' in a shipping build.
The caches are cleared at the first update, on vehicle change and when an actions/*.json file is modified.

Inconsistencies: the comment of executeCommand announces 'returns the executed action count' but for the vlua context it returns the return value of queueCmd, which returns nothing (nil); the duplicate action messages use `vid`, out of scope in the normal actions loop (prints nil).

menuIndependentPrefix.desc: 'MenuIndependent_': prefix of the ActionMaps whose action declares actionMap = 'MenuIndependent'.

menuActionMapNames.desc: Set of 'menu independent' ActionMap names (pushed as soon as they are created). Cleared and rebuilt on every read of the active actions.

getActiveActions.desc: Currently active actions: actions of existing vehicles (marked cat 'vehicle_specific' if usable, otherwise 'vehicle_specific_unusable') plus the common actions. Creates the missing C++ ActionMaps along the way.

getInactiveActions.desc: Disabled actions (license or _nonshipping files in a shipping build).

upgradeAction.desc: Resolves an action name: returns the name if it is active; recursively follows the replacements of core_input_deprecatedActions; returns nil (with a log) if the action is inactive, obsolete or unknown.

actionToCommands.desc: Converts an action into parameters used by the engine on triggering. Determines the ActionMap (Normal, Menu, VehicleCommon, VehicleSpecific, or the action's own), the onChange/onDown/onUp callbacks, the command context and isCentered. Logs invalid categories and deprecated contexts.

actionCache.desc: Already known definition of the action; only needed when the call comes from getActions (avoids infinite recursion).

nameToUniqueName.desc: Prefixes the action name with the vehicle name: '<vehicle>__<action>'.

uniqueNameToName.desc: Inverse operation: removes the '<vehicle>__' prefix. Logs an error and returns the name unchanged if the prefix is missing.

executeCommand.desc: Executes an action's code: vlua -> sent to vehicle vehicleId; elua/tlua -> Lua:queueLuaCommand (GE); bvlua -> to all objects. onDown is used if actionValue == 1, onUp if actionValue == 0, otherwise onChange. The tokens VALUE, VEHICLEID, PLAYER, TRIGGERID… are replaced in the code.

evt.desc: Action definition with ctx (nil = vlua), onDown, onUp, onChange.

actionValue.desc: Action value (1 = press, 0 = release, or analog value for onChange).

vehicleId.desc: Id of the target vehicle (vlua context).

triggerId.desc: Value for TRIGGERID (empty string if nil).

returns.desc: 1 for GE/bvlua if a command was sent, 0 otherwise; for vlua the return value of queueCmd, hence nil (see notes).

triggerDown.desc: Simulates the press of a named action (ActionMap.triggerBindingByNameDigital(name, true)).

triggerUp.desc: Simulates the release of a named action.

triggerDownUp.desc: Simulates an immediate press then release.

onFirstUpdate.desc: Hook at first update: clears the actions cache.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook on player vehicle change: clears the actions cache (the specific actions change).

onFileChanged.desc: File modification hook: if a JSON under /lua/ge/extensions/core/input/actions changes, clears the caches.
